name: Internet Academy
summary: Small Adelaide ISP (academy.net.au) + web design + internet training; defunct ~2003.

events.details: Adelaide ISP/web design/training (site from Dec 1996). Principal: Steve Goodridge (SAIA), per its own pages.

Defunct by ~2003 (no sale recorded). The homepage still pitched ISP services in Feb 2006 and was an SEO business by Nov 2006 — death c. 2006, so both the current and proposed c. 2003 dates are too early.

refs.label: 9 Feb 2006: homepage title still sells the business as an Adelaide ISP.
By 7 Nov 2006 the homepage identity was an SEO/web business (same page persists at the live domain in 2026 — non-ISP survival does not extend ISP death).
Own 2006 page names principal Steve Goodridge; no Pty Ltd or ABN anywhere on the long-lived site.
Earliest capture uses the 'Academy Internet' trading style only.
